name: [1M!🎉] Eternal Rarities X!
desc:
Welcome to Eternal Rarities X! This game is a mix of the original Eternal Rarities and the 2nd Eternal Rarities, where the graphics have been improved but the core gameplay has stayed the same! It is an Incremental, Simulator, RNG and Grindy game!

Check out the new 1M Event🎉!

Roll your Rarity! 🍀
Reset and upgrade your Luck! ✖️
Get even better Rarities! 📈
Roll Runes to boost all of your stats! 💲💲💲
Climb the leaderboards to be on top!🔝

Update log:
- Added a New Area: Volcano! 🌋
- 4 new Stats! 📈
- Added a New Rune!🔮
- Added a New Leaderboard! 📋
- Added 2 New Gamepasses! 💲
- Fixed Bugs! 🪲
Enjoy!
